==Usage instructions==
Add {{Tl|IV}} to the top of the page to start a [[Wookieepedia:Consensus#Infobox image consensus votes|consensus vote]] to determine that article's main infobox image.

In the event the page has undergone for an infobox image consensus votes one or more times previously, you will need to add the number of the vote as a parameter to the template (e.g. <code><nowiki>{{IV|second}}</nowiki></code>).

==Categorization==
*[[:Category:Pages undergoing an infobox image consensus vote]]
